This request is for the acquisition of two 86-inch BenQ Interactive Display Units to support
operational efficiency, enhance collaboration, and replace aging equipment within our
For purposes of this QQ, this bid is restricted to Bidders that have been approved/pre-
qualified by the Riverside County Information Technology (RCIT) department to be able to
provide hardware that meets or exceeds the County of Riverside Hardware Standards.
The anticipated delivery of the hardware specifications in this Quick Quote shall be
delivered on or before November 30, 2026 to Riverside County, Department of Public Social
Services (DPSS) Administrative Services Division – Technology Support Services (TSS) at
Delivery appointments MUST be made with the County of Riverside Department of

contact person will be provided upon award of bid. The County will not be responsible
for cost incurred due to shipments attempted during non-receiving hours or
unscheduled deliveries. All delivery of products must be F.O.B. Destination.
